derivation: amendment A15: 'Two pages may not share a `file`.' The clause sits in the input-fault block whose id vocabulary is closed (input_unreadable, input_duplicate_url, input_url_not_absolute); a shared file is neither a duplicate url nor a non-absolute url, so the fault is `input_unreadable`, emitted once for the offending (second) manifest entry under A2.
name: input-shared-file
